principles.population: organization owners contain zero demographic bodies; members and leaders are references to exact existing people
principles.military: armed branches remain separate normal conserved force and formation owners
principles.finance: organization spending is limited to its exact treasury
principles.projects: physical projects use the shared funded institution-project engine and exact local labor/material inputs
principles.scale: routine organizations remain cold/reference-only until materially persistent; no one-record-per-member expansion

autonomy.rule: bounded exact-owner review; no people or money are created, and autonomous admission is limited to pre-nominated exact candidates
